# Polyhedral dice

Source: [Polyhedral RPG Gaming Dice - Dec 2014](https://openclipart.org/detail/210817/polyhedral-rpg-gaming-dice-dec-2014) by jpneok.
Downloaded from https://openclipart.org/download/210817 on 2026-11-07.
License: CC0 1.0 (public domain), https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Openclipart license policy: https://openclipart.org/share

Adaptations: extracted the six standard dice, removed metadata, normalized each model to a 64-unit canvas, replaced red and black with currentColor and unified stroke widths. Numerals are supplied by the application.
